route: C: observation-conditioned warm initializer for three-dimensional BOST reconstruction
headline: v95.1 improves the strict Case 6 joint-pass count from 78/90 to 81/90, but no frozen observation-only strategy passes all 90 cells
headline_zh: v95.1 的 observation-only 线性预测与折内回退把严格通过从 78/90 提高到 81/90，但没有达到 90/90；当前九维小模型路线正式失败。
next_scientific_gate: freeze a minimal observation-adaptive direction-capacity diagnostic that uses only deployment-visible residual and known geometry, nests the current nine-dimensional family, and asks whether truth-aware coefficients can repair all seven common failures at the same 2A+2AT online budget before any larger predictor is trained
next_scientific_gate_zh: 先冻结 observation-adaptive direction 容量诊断：新方向只能由部署可见 residual 与 known geometry 生成，必须嵌套现有九维表示，并在同一 2A+2A^T 在线预算下先证明七个共同失败能被全部修复；容量过 90/90 前不训练大模型、不租 GPU。
